text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Y-You......
You came here on your own...? To train...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What a strange question to ask, Air Groove-san.
There's only one thing to do here, and that is train.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
Let us take the route with the fewest possible moves.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To strike the finishing blow in the endgame, boosting stamina and burst power is top priority.
Personally, I want a decisive clincher to seal the checkmate.
choice_data_list: Let's start with the uphill slopes!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh—I shall demonstrate results in no time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Miso soup loaded with Japanese mustard spinach and tofu provides plenty of iron
and plant-based protein... and stir-fried liver and garlic chives covers vitamin B1.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I've thoroughly mapped out all the match patterns, too...
All that's left is relentlessly boosting stamina and power. Yes, right on schedule.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Considering the weather forecast, the board state might be rougher than anticipated...
I need to raise my base stats a bit more. Time to up the load...!)

Just as she laid out herself, Rulership executes each phase
with lively precision. Moving steadily forward all on her own—

She will surely seize a splendid victory in the debutants' race
with that extraordinary strategic mind of hers.

Just as forecasted, the debutants' race takes place under unfortunate rain.
I watch over Rulership from the stands alongside Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—To think that fool signed up for a debutants' race of her own accord...
I wonder how this will unfold...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The board is already in the palm of my hand—dance to your heart's content.
choice_data_list: (She can definitely win... I know she can!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: All runners set—and they're off in the debutants' race!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this?! Number 13, Rulership,
lags far behind the pack and starts dead last!
choice_data_list: (It's fine, all part of the plan...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Vying for the lead are numbers 5, 9, and 12—yes, largely standard openings.
The board is spreading out slightly... but the gap is well within calculations.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(In that case, the optimal line is on the outside after all.
The moment to initiate tactics—is the third corner!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And here comes Rulership making a massive surge!
Isn't it a bit early to make her move?! Can she hold on?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh—in the past, I wouldn't have been able to master this endgame.
I lacked the power to push through with optimal moves and perfect timing, after all...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However! Having prepared for this very day—I now possess that "power"!
HAAAAAAAH!!

Her acceleration is breathtaking.
With every stride she steadily closes in on the lead, sweeping past in an instant—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Rulership takes the lead and blows past them to the finish!!
What a magnificent late charge!!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... look at that burst of speed. She has phenomenal legs.
To think that girl could run with such composure...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, haha, ahahaha...! 
Flawless...! Ahh————what an absolute rush.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Racing isn't bad at all... I see, so this is how you clear it...
This might be so fun it feels like a whole different game...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Greetings. Did you see that, Trainer?
choice_data_list: That was amazing! You really are incredible!
That was fantastic! You truly are extraordinary!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Well, it was a foregone conclusion.
Besides, I must say you have quite the discerning eye yourself.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
............Yes, I rather like it. Having a right-hand aide isn't so bad...
Taking command of this board seems entertaining enough.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I shall grant you front-row seats to witness my triumphs.
You have plenty to look forward to.
choice_data_list: Yes, I'm really looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.text:
At this rate, a splendid trainer is sure to scout her in no time.
As one of her fans, I look forward to seeing her future success!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And so, I will be making my debut, Air Groove-san.
Just as you wished, I shall fully fulfill my "duty as a Tracen Academy student."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Together with my right-hand aide right here, that is.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
choice_data_list: Ah, um, sorry, you caught me off guard...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......Ruler.
You haven't actually discussed a trainer contract yet, have you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, but that goes without saying............ Wait, what?
You're captivated by my genius, aren't you? You want to be my trainer, right?

Her ability and strategic brilliance are so high she doesn't even need my help.
If she's entering a contract, it should be with someone who can offer her far greater benefits.
choice_data_list: That's why I felt I wasn't worthy...
That's why I thought I wouldn't be fit for the job...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
————Ha, haha. Ah... I see... To think that even *I*
made such an egregious miscalculation... Haha... This is the worst................

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
————NO WAY!! No no no no nooooo~~~~~~ Why would you do that, you idiot!
You should have figured that much out already, think about itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're the nicest of them all! You never get mad and you play board games with me!
It's you, absolutely YOU as my trainer!! Otherwise, I'm quitting everything!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Sign or give up!! It's one or the otherrrr~~!!

I'm hit with an unexpected ultimatum.
Either sign a contract with her, or she throws in the towel and quits entirely.

—There is only one answer.
I cannot allow her extraordinary talent to be buried over something like this!
choice_data_list: I'd love nothing more than to be your trainer! Let's sign!
I would be honored to be your trainer! Let's make it official!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yayyy—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—*Ahem*... Ah... Well, of course, of course.
You are utterly enthralled by my talent, after all. A natural conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I shall enter a contract with you.
I look forward to working with you as my right hand, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm counting on you. Truly.
choice_data_list: I'll take full responsibility and look after her...

text_block_list.text:
Trading bows with Air Groove, I steel my resolve.
Not as a mere spectator anymore, but as someone who will support her from here on out.

Let's give it our all for Rulership's brilliant racing career.
—Above all else, keeping her mental well-being in top shape!
